intro.tagline: Automatically publish RSS feeds, podcasts and YouTube channels to your Telegram channels.

setup.title: Set up your first bot
setup.subtitle: Four questions and Titan is ready to publish.
setup.step1Desc: A name to help you recognise it: only you see it.
setup.step2Desc: You get it from @BotFather on Telegram when you create the bot.
setup.step3Desc: The channel to publish to. The bot must be one of its administrators.
setup.step4Desc: Items published in the feeds before this date are ignored.

engine.stoppedHint: Nothing is published until you start it
engine.scanNowHint: Reads every active source right away, without waiting for its interval
engine.scanBusy: A check is already running: the next one starts as soon as it finishes.

workspace.emptyText: Create a bot, connect it to your Telegram channel and add the sources to publish.

botForm.newDescription: Connect a Telegram bot to a channel. Sources are added right after.
botForm.name: Bot name
botForm.nameHint: Only you see it, in the bot list.
botForm.tokenHint: You get it from @BotFather on Telegram.
botForm.tokenShape: This doesn't look like a BotFather token (digits, a colon, then a long string of letters). Check you copied all of it.
botForm.tokenMissing: The token can't be read on this computer (a profile imported from another PC?): paste it again.
botForm.channelHint: @channelname, the t.me address or the numeric ID (-100…). The bot must be one of its administrators.
botForm.startDateHint: Items older than this date are ignored.

botSettings.title: Bot settings
botSettings.activeHint: When disabled, the engine skips it and publishes nothing.
botSettings.notificationsHint: A system notification for every item published.
botSettings.silentStartHint: When you start the engine, this bot gets to work without posting in the channel: no startup message. For chats and channels that would rather not see it.
botSettings.intervalHint: How often to check the sources, from 1 to 1440 minutes. Individual sources can have their own interval.
botSettings.intervalRange: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1440.
botSettings.windowHint: Outside these hours, new items wait in a queue and go out as soon as the window reopens.
botSettings.exportText: An .rtb file with settings and sources, to import on another computer. The token stays readable only on this one.
botSettings.clearText: Titan forgets what it has already published: items still in the feeds and newer than the start date will be published again.
botSettings.clearConfirmText: On the next run the bot will republish the items still in its sources and newer than the start date. This cannot be undone.
botSettings.deleteText: Deletes the bot with its sources and history. The Telegram channel is not touched.
botSettings.deleteConfirmText: The bot, its sources and its history are deleted. This cannot be undone.
botSettings.muteHint: Subscribers receive the messages as usual, but their phone does not ring or vibrate. Useful at night, or for channels that post often.
botSettings.muteSummaryWindow: Without sound from {from} to {until}, with sound for the rest of the day.

a11y.zoomShortcuts: From the keyboard: Ctrl and + to zoom in, Ctrl and − to zoom out, Ctrl and 0 to go back to 100%. The setting is saved.

youtubeError.message: YouTube has changed something and videos from some channels can't be read. Other feeds keep working. If it persists, disable the YouTube sources for now and check whether a Titan update is available.

credits.title: Credits
credits.body:
This program was written making heavy use of large language models: Google Gemini, from 2.5 to 3.1, and Anthropic Claude, from Sonnet 4.6 to Opus 5.5. Most of the code came from them.

Everything else belongs to Simone Pizzi: the concept, the vision, the design direction, the meticulous definition of every detail and the stubborn hunt for bugs. The models wrote the code, the decisions were all Simone Pizzi's.
credits.short: Built with the help of LLMs · conceived and directed by Simone Pizzi

support.sectionDesc: Titan is free and open source. If you find it useful, you can leave a donation or get in touch through the contact page.

botCheck.title: Test the bot
botCheck.hint: Checks the token, the destination and the permissions with Telegram, without posting anything. You can do it before saving, too.
botCheck.allGood: All good: the bot can post in this chat.
botCheck.token_invalid: not valid. Telegram does not recognise this bot: copy the token again from @BotFather.
botCheck.token_network: Telegram is not answering. Check your connection and try again.
botCheck.chat_notFound: not found. Check the address; a private channel needs its numeric ID (-100…).
botCheck.chat_noAccess: the bot cannot see it. Add it to the channel or group.
botCheck.chat_network: Telegram is not answering. Check your connection and try again.
botCheck.chat_skipped: not checked, a valid token is needed first.
botCheck.rights_notMember: the bot is not part of the chat. Add it as an administrator.
botCheck.rights_notAdmin: the bot is a subscriber but not an administrator. In a channel only administrators can post.
botCheck.rights_noPostRight: the bot is an administrator without the “Post messages” permission. Turn it on in the channel settings.
botCheck.rights_restricted: the bot is restricted in this group and cannot write.
botCheck.rights_network: Telegram is not answering. Check your connection and try again.
botCheck.rights_skipped: not checked, a reachable destination is needed first.
